limits: Native macOS development app uses controlled local providers and disposable mock credential storage. No paid subscription, native Keychain or installed-release qualification.
The native crash scenarios stop at provider boundaries after one completed file effect; they do not establish arbitrary mid-tool external-effect recovery.
Reconciliation branches are tested against actual database states; this is not a PostgreSQL protocol-proxy test of every possible transport failure timing.
Parent transcript persistence and inbox admission are not one database transaction. Private child contexts are not restart-restored. Old runs remain historical/unconfirmed and are not auto-resumed.
Contract-revision composition, broader hierarchy/cross-chat routing, terminal/broker crash reconciliation, native Windows/Linux and installed-app gates remain open.
